clips.title: The story
paras: Alliance agents work under Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. From the peaks, they enter the Venture Company lumber mill in Windshear Crag to recover engineering schematics.

Gaxim Rustfizzle directs a covert effort from Windshear Crag against the Venture Company's aggressive logging. Goblin loggers cut timber south of Cragpool Lake, but destruction alone cannot stop them. Plan Alpha sends agents past the loggers and overseers to take the mill's technical schematics.

The Venture Company's schematics interest gnomes for more than the night elves' forests. The plans show how goblin loggers, mechanical cutters and mechanized transports work. Alliance engineers can use them to find structural flaws and break up future operations, while adapting goblin designs for their own projects in Ironforge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This is it, friend. Pay close attention. The devices are done, and ready to be used.
Take these pages—they'll explain more about the detonators and explosives, and where you should place them.

Remember, the success of your mission doesn't depend on how much destruction you cause. Plan Alpha's success depends on you bringing back the Venture Co.'s engineering plans from inside the lumber mill south of Cragpool Lake.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the plans, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Truly amazing! This is a huge blow to the Venture Co.
We'll be able to find weaknesses in their machines and also incorporate their designs into our own creations. This is a wonderful day, indeed.
